title: Chart bars changing colors unexpectedly
text: I’m hoping some long-term Ninjatrader users can advise Lately I’ve been using non-default bar colors for some testing a new indicator. I keep the bars black & white so that I can see easily what the indicators is doing. I load a chart template with these colors. The issue I have is that sometimes… not every time… when I switch timeframe or instrument, the bars go back to the default green/red… Like awful green/red - even the wicks are green/red, there’s no border on the bars and the bars are too thin as well. It is driving me nuts and causing me a lot of wasted time. Either setting the chart up from scratch again or manually fixing the bar colors. Any idea how to stop this happening?
triage_reason: Chart indicator resetting custom bar colors unexpectedly on timeframe switches.
